about: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next Coder (ISTA-DASLab GSQ-RCO IQ1_M: 256 of each layer's 512 experts kept, stored like IQ3_S) on one 12 GB card with Strata 0.1.40 (github.com/Niko1221/Strata): a VRAM expert cache auto-sized from free VRAM, the experts the GPU does not hold page-locked in RAM (low-RAM resident mode, no file reads while serving once warm), the 29 GB n-gram lookup shard read from the SSD, MTP speculative decoding (4 drafts) from the original checkpoint's MTP layer, int8 KV, 64K window.
install: git clone https://github.com/Niko1221/Strata && git -C Strata checkout 82f46a8c8f475f001ad76d92f58f4a4f8ffb0253 && cd Strata && ./setup.sh --family coder --context 65536 --vision no --low-ram resident --build --no-start --yes (compiles engine 0.1.40 for sm_120; engine/strata sha256 d1c8fc79180c936d8c9e6f69271d4ccd6a77104f49a7094869329bd04baba387; setup downloads the pinned GGUF shards, builds the pack and fetches the MTP layer, and writes strata-coder-iq1_m.json)
setup: NEEDS: one 12 GB NVIDIA card (sm_120 build), 32 GB RAM, ~80 GB on a local NVMe SSD (55 GB GGUF + 25 GB pack + MTP layer). Strata sizes the page-locked expert set at start from MemAvailable minus 4 GiB (at most 19.11 GiB for this model) and reads the experts it could not pin from the GGUF through the OS file cache: measured 19.85 GiB pinned at 51.4 tok/s and 15.78 GiB pinned at 50.4 tok/s (Strata's own token counts; the lab's speed gate estimates tokens as chars/4 because Strata has no tokenize endpoint, so its tps reads ~30% low). MemAvailable dropped 18.6 GB from start through the gates (swap grew 7.5 GB as the kernel made room). VRAM: 11.7 GB peak; Strata warns only ~215 MiB stays free with the desktop on the same GPU.
